svg.title: The levistack routing stack
svg.desc: Every task routed through use-levistack takes seven steps: route, prime, invoke, hunt, apply, prove, deliver. Rules, hooks, agents, one-shots, focus skills and upstream plugins wrap the session.

g.text: Every task takes the same seven steps.
Nothing counts as done without proof. Nothing leaves the session without your yes.
Type /start (or /use-levistack) and your task. It picks the skill, runs it, proves it and shapes the reply.
Prime and deliver always run. Hunt runs only when no first skill is clear. A skill you name skips step 04.
root install: 41 skills, 11 agents, 41 rules, 13 commands, 5 opt-in hooks, 2 upstream plugins as dependencies · group plugins ship skills only
Start here. The entry point for every task.
A skill you name inside it runs as a one-shot.
Reads your prompt to pick the job, the safety needs and the reply length. It never rewrites your words.
It also notes what the workspace already answers: the branch, git status, the latest handoff note.
Picks the first skill from what you want. No clear fit goes to step 04.
Asks at most three questions, searches the catalog, and builds a chain of up to four skills.
Goes to skills.sh only when nothing here fits, and installs only after your yes.
Runs the chain one skill at a time. Each result goes to the next skill in one sentence.
41 skills in 8 groups · a subagent can take one bounded job and report back
Every claim gets fresh proof before the reply says done. Anything that leaves the session waits for you.
fresh proof that matches the claim
the MR exists, the push landed,
The same session shapes the reply before it leaves the chat.
plain words for text people read: MR text, comments, email · code, ids and commands stay exact
last gate on the reply · keeps proof lines, rollback steps and "not verified" lines
Wraps the whole session. Not a numbered step.
5 core rules are always on. The rest load by topic or file.
core 14 · architecture 15 · elixir 7 · go 3 · python 1 · design 1
the agent proves / you approve what goes out
Run on tool calls, so they work even when the agent forgets.
careful-guard · asks before rm -rf, force-push, reset --hard
generated-file-guard · asks before it edits generated files
large-read-guard · blocks full reads over 350 lines
session-start · adds a digest of the always-on rules
notify-done · pings you when the agent finishes
Name a skill inside /use-levistack: prime, run it, prove,
deliver. There is no step 04 hunt.
A bare /skill call runs that skill alone, with no prime or deliver.
A helper takes one bounded job and reports back.
Stuck or pulled off track? These work at any point.
Own repos, own plugins. Installing or updating
levistack pulls them in as dependencies.

svg.text: 41 skills · 11 agents · 41 rules · 13 commands · 5 hooks · 2 upstream · 25 OCT 2026
